models.code:
class Customer(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'customer'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    name = Column(String)
    balance = Column(Numeric, default=0)
    credit_limit = Column(Numeric)
models.description: Customer entity representing individual customers in the system.
models.name: Customer

models.code:
class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'order'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    customer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('customer.id'))
    amount_total = Column(Numeric, default=0)
    date_shipped = Column(DateTime)
    notes = Column(String)
    customer = relationship('Customer')
models.name: Order

models.code:
class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'item'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    order_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('order.id'))
    product_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('product.id'))
    unit_price = Column(Numeric)
    quantity = Column(Integer)
    amount = Column(Numeric, default=0)
    order = relationship('Order')
    product = relationship('Product')
models.description: Item entity representing order line items.
models.name: Item

models.code:
class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'product'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    name = Column(String)
    unit_price = Column(Numeric)
models.name: Product
